description: the target cylinder of cross-cylinders-common minus the tool: πR²L − 16R³/3 in two touching lumps, above and below the tool. Each lump has its own vertices at (0, ±R, 0), where the walls touch (ADR-0090)

analytic.counts_differ: Open CASCADE's two solids share the crossing vertices and can split ellipse arcs at their parameter origin. Arris copies the crossing vertices per lump.
analytic.occt_step_counts_differ: Open CASCADE writes 11 distinct vertices instead of its 9 in memory, giving each solid its own crossing vertices.
